name: Canvas Low-Top
description: A minimalist canvas low-top sneaker in heathered off-white cotton canvas with a natural gum rubber sole and toe cap, cotton laces, and brass eyelets.
materials: heathered cotton canvas upper, natural gum rubber sole and toe cap, cotton laces, brass eyelets
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, tab, patch, or printed/woven lettering anywhere on the shoe; never add lugged tread to the sole, it stays smooth ribbed vulcanized gum rubber; never flatten the canvas into a solid uniform color, it must keep its heathered fleck Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: keep the gum rubber sole translucent honey-tan, never painted solid white or grey, and keep the canvas weave's heathered two-tone flecking visible up close across every angle; keep all surfaces entirely plain and unmarked When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
